name: Ollama
description: Ollama provider for running local LLMs on your own machine.

OLLAMA_API_ENDPOINT.label: Api Endpoint
OLLAMA_API_ENDPOINT.help: Base URL for the Ollama API (local, Fly private URL, or Ollama Cloud). Normalized to end with /api.

OLLAMA_BASE_URL.label: Base Url
OLLAMA_BASE_URL.help: Compatibility auto-enable key for a running Ollama server (without /api).

OLLAMA_SMALL_MODEL.label: Small Model
OLLAMA_SMALL_MODEL.help: Fast 1.5B Solana/core agent model tag from local ollama list.

OLLAMA_MEDIUM_MODEL.label: Medium Model
OLLAMA_MEDIUM_MODEL.help: 8B trading LoRA used for planners and medium text.

OLLAMA_LARGE_MODEL.label: Large Model
OLLAMA_LARGE_MODEL.help: On-chain specialist ~35B MoE model for heavy reasoning.

OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_MODEL.label: Embedding Model
OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_MODEL.help: Ollama embedding model. Pull with: ollama pull nomic-embed-text

SMALL_MODEL.label: Model
SMALL_MODEL.help: Fallback for small model if OLLAMA_SMALL_MODEL is not set.

LARGE_MODEL.label: Model
LARGE_MODEL.help: Fallback for large model if OLLAMA_LARGE_MODEL is not set.
